title: High Order semi-implicit Rosenbrock type and Multistep methods for evolutionary partial differential equations with higher order derivatives
summary: The aim of this work is to apply a semi-implicit (SI) strategy within a Rosenbrock-type and IMEX linear multistep (LM) framework to a sequence of 1D time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs) with high order spatial derivatives. This strategy provides great flexibility to treat these equations, and allows the construction of simple lienarly implicit schemes without any Newton iteration.
